scope: Authority/preservation coverage of every tracked blob at baseline; not a claim every script was behaviorally audited

authority.owner: Repository owner: production deployment/activation, private data, secrets and frozen research
authority.engineering: Lead engineer: explicitly reviewed development-branch source/test/docs repairs; no implicit deployment
authority.individualMaintainers: Not inferred; no invented personal assignments

rules.OWNER_PRIVATE_DATA: Preserve existing bytes/modes; no secret access or changes without explicit authorization
rules.FROZEN_RESEARCH: Preserve original rejected/first/corrected verdicts; new corrections require distinct evidence
rules.OWNER_ACTIVATION: No marker/approval/Phase A activation without explicit owner approval
rules.OWNER_SECURITY_CONFIGURATION: No private-data/secret configuration edits without owner review
rules.PRODUCTION_DATA: Preserve every existing production data blob during engineering
rules.WORKFLOW_BRANCH_REVIEW: Branch repairs only; review writes/concurrency/failure/default-branch execution before deployment
rules.TEST_FIXTURE: Disposable fixture evidence only, no historical result replacement
rules.ENGINEERING_DOCUMENTATION: Accurate evidence and chronology; no invented approval/results
rules.ENGINEERING_SOURCE: Explicit branch fixes and regressions; preserve registered strategy thresholds
rules.MANUAL_REVIEW: Other project assets require explicit review; no inferred live authorization
